name: axis_pinch
description: Parallel-jaw grasp placed in the object's principal frame (offsets along the long and short axes, closing angle relative to the long axis). Search space for oriented and elongated shapes; never chosen by the planner directly.

along.unit: fraction of the half long extent

across.unit: fraction of the half short extent

close_deg.unit: closing direction vs the short axis (0 = across the long axis)

check: fingers closed on the object: 3 mm < finger width < 76 mm
